text: answer[task-49157417]: accepted The cancel frame was rejected because cancellation is only valid while the contract remains proposed; once the offer was accepted, the contract entered the accepted state and could proceed only through the subsequent lock, claim, or refund transitions. The accept frame correctly referenced the offer and established the contract, while the later payer-issued cancel frame could not terminate an already accepted contract. Therefore, the fold’s final status is accepted, with no valid cancellation applied.
